high_level_description: The image depicts a scene from the first phase of the Lok Sabha elections in Manipur's West Imphal constituency. The text at the top of the image informs us that the Election Commission of India (ECI) ordered repolling in 11 booths of the Inner Manipur seat after incidents of violence were reported from various polling stations in the constituency. The photograph shows a broken Electronic Voting Machine (EVM) lying on the ground inside what appears to be a polling booth. The EVM is in a disassembled state, with its components scattered around it.
